objective: Exhaustively rank the complete u32 base-seed space for one prospectively fixed CURRENT_PMG_GATE_UP_DIRECT_BF16 family using one exact binary64 source objective, then validate exactly one frozen winner before running fixed-seed controls as a one-shot falsification and correction panel.

scientific_claim.required_chronology_attestation: The ABI choice, inherited coordinate sets, K values, arithmetic, thresholds, and post-selection control rule were fixed without consulting any target payload statistic, prior candidate score, or validation output. Failure to authenticate that chronology is a hard BLOCK.
scientific_claim.required_validation_firewall: The validation identities and bytes must be inaccessible to every selection process until one descriptor, all selection metrics, all Top-K states, and the no-retry sentinel are durably committed. Any prior use of this validation panel to choose the ABI, protocol, seed, coordinates, K, threshold, or arithmetic is a hard BLOCK.
scientific_claim.multiplicity_resolution: All 2^32 candidates are compared on selection data, but only one deterministically chosen descriptor is opened against an untouched validation panel. Candidate multiplicity is therefore handled by a strict train/validation firewall, not by a matched-control search or an exchangeability claim.
scientific_claim.control_correction: On the one frozen descriptor and validation panel only: corrected_capture = source_capture - max(0, maximum fixed-descriptor capture among the 32 frozen controls).
scientific_claim.negative_result_scope: A failure rejects only this one ABI, exact cascade, exact coordinate plan and one-shot validation protocol. It is not proof that no procedural initializer state can help.
scientific_claim.positive_result_scope: Auxiliary evidence for this one compatibility ABI. It is not proof of release-producer lineage and does not by itself supply the Gate-role affine cells required by the final codec.
stop_with_block_if: the prospective chronology cannot be independently authenticated
the validation panel is not demonstrably untouched and isolated
a control is permitted to select or reselect a seed
a failed source or control result can trigger another descriptor, ABI, coordinate, K, arithmetic or threshold
a p-value, exchangeability result, or matched-search multiplicity correction is inferred from fixed-descriptor controls

candidate_family.prospective_choice_basis: the single later pinned projection-major, per-local-expert, gate-then-up compatibility ABI already frozen as ABI1 in FUSEED-U32-v1; choice is by public-source/runtime lineage only
candidate_family.effective_seed: base_seed_u32 + 1024 + 100*(global_expert//32), evaluated as mathematical u64 addition with carry

coordinate_protocol.reuse_rule: Re-enumerate the exact FUSEED-U32-v1 plan, including its cross-ABI opposite-split collision history, then retain exactly the ABI1 stage0 records. Reuse the exact v1 common stage1, full-selection and validation canonical sets. No coordinate is newly sampled for v2.
coordinate_protocol.stage0_execution_order: category up_fit, down_fit, up_score, down_score; then expert ascending; then accepted bundle index ascending; then native lanes 0,1,2,3
coordinate_protocol.emitted_bundle_line_grammar: bundle|index=DDD|category=ROLE_SPLIT|e=DDD|role=ROLE|split=SPLIT|accepted=DD|seed_delta=INT|offset=INT|scale=8hex|seq=INT|j=INT|laneL=rDDD,cDDDD,nativeINT for L=0..3; UTF-8 lines joined by LF with terminal LF

exact_source_objective.metric_wire: IEEE-754 binary64 little-endian; finite only; negative zero canonicalized to positive zero
exact_source_objective.total_order: capture binary64 descending, then base_seed_u32 ascending
exact_source_objective.target_input_precision: target values binary32, widened exactly to binary64 before every moment operation
exact_source_objective.anchor_precision: role-scaled binary32 rounded once to BF16 round-to-nearest-even, widened exactly to binary64
exact_source_objective.moment_precision: all sums, squares, cross-products, centered moments, affine calculations, SSE, baseline and capture are binary64
exact_source_objective.accumulation_order: the category-ordered bundle array, lanes 0 through 3; separate accumulators per role and fit/score category
exact_source_objective.operation_contract: Every addition, subtraction, multiplication and division has an explicit parenthesized order and round-to-nearest-even result. Contraction is forbidden except at source locations explicitly written as a correctly rounded binary64 fused multiply-add; reassociation and reduced precision are forbidden.
exact_source_objective.affine_contract: For each role, fit alpha and mu from fit moments; independently round alpha and mu to finite IEEE binary16 little-endian, reload and widen to binary64, then score only the score split.
exact_source_objective.degenerate_fit_rule: If centered anchor energy is not strictly positive, alpha_raw is exactly +0; mu_raw is the fit target mean.
exact_source_objective.negative_sse_rule: A finite negative SSE caused only by final rounding is clamped to +0 before capture; a negative baseline, zero baseline, nonfinite value or nonrepresentable affine aborts the entire cell.

direct_generator_contract.counter: C=(sequence<<64)+(initializer_offset>>2)+normal4_index modulo 2^128 with carry across all four u32 words
direct_generator_contract.scale_then_bf16: binary32 round-to-nearest scale multiplication, BF16 round-to-nearest-even, exact widen

stage0.record_wire: packed 12 bytes exactly: seed_u32 little-endian followed immediately by capture binary64 little-endian; no alignment padding

validation.open_rule: one descriptor, every selection metric and state hash, the applicable threshold, and a no-retry sentinel must be durably sealed before validation is made visible

cascade.topk_union_theorem: For one strict total order, TopK(A union B) is contained in TopK(A) union TopK(B); exact shard Top-K followed by exact rolling Top-K equals exact global stage0 Top-K.

post_selection_controls.fit_and_score_rule: Each domain gets its own decoded-FP16 affine fit on the fixed validation-fit coordinates and is scored only on fixed validation-score coordinates for the same frozen descriptor.
post_selection_controls.promotion_rule: corrected source capture minus 3 whole-expert standard errors must meet the applicable threshold; uncorrected source must exceed every control; every expert/role fold must be positive; all values and affine cells must be finite; failure is terminal
post_selection_controls.interpretation: descriptive one-shot falsification and conservative capture subtraction only; not a matched exhaustive search, exchangeable orbit, randomization test or familywise p-value

retention_protocol.reason: The exhaustive stage0 objective is exact, but sparse stage0 and stage1 Top-K can still discard the full-selection winner.
retention_protocol.cell_mapping: for i=0..255: concentration=(7*i+floor(i/3))%5; role=(11*i+floor(i/5))%5; coordinate=(13*i+floor(i/7))%5; shared=(5*i+floor(i/11))%3; scale=(7*i+floor(i/13))%3; residual=(11*i+floor(i/17))%3
retention_protocol.boundary_suite: seed 0, UINT32_MAX, every shard boundary, all effective-seed carry boundaries, all counter lanes, affine finite extrema, denominator degeneracy, exact binary64 and one-ulp cutoff ties
retention_protocol.failed_cell_action: hard BLOCK with no payload access and no changed K, coordinate, arithmetic or stress retry

future_hardened_calibration.exact_shape: one complete 2^24-seed shard, exact ABI1 category-ordered plan, one binary64 source objective, exact packed Top-8192, durable shard journal and exact rolling merge
future_hardened_calibration.projection: median complete warm shard wall times 256 plus one-time cold selection excess, all journal/global-merge costs, separately measured stage1, stage2 and one-descriptor validation
future_hardened_calibration.failure_action: hard BLOCK; do not change the ABI, plan, precision, K, shard size or 900-second limit

journal_protocol.path_firewall: Resolve raw and canonical source/output roots, component identities, file IDs, device/mount IDs and full ancestry; require pairwise disjoint roots and reject aliases, links, reparse points, bind overlays and unexpected mounts.
journal_protocol.shard_key: design hash, emitted-plan hash, toolchain-closure hash, parity hash, target-source commitment, shard ordinal, shard start, count, metric wire, total order and K
journal_protocol.shard_record: header plus exactly 8192 packed seed/capture records, finite sentinel, scanned-candidate count 2^24, first/last seed, kernel-output digest, selector digest and parent-chain digest
journal_protocol.durability: write a same-directory temporary file, flush file data and metadata, atomically rename, then flush the parent directory before marking complete
journal_protocol.resume: authenticate the entire regular-file non-link closure and exact expected member set before accepting a shard; reject duplicates, gaps, overlap, hash drift, partial files or unexpected members
journal_protocol.global_merge: prove exactly 256 adjacent shards cover u32 once, merge under the frozen total order, and require a second legal merge tree to produce identical record bytes and digest
journal_protocol.validation_commit: one descriptor, stage0/stage1/stage2 metrics and Top-K hashes, selection source commitment, applicable threshold, no-retry sentinel, control definitions and validation-plan hash are committed before validation root visibility
journal_protocol.failure_action: hard BLOCK; no repair-in-place or partial resume under changed bytes

decision.selection_early_kill_composite: before validation, stop if uncorrected source capture + 3 whole-expert SE is below 0.1456888483858212 because post-control correction cannot increase it
decision.selection_early_kill_standalone: if no separately finite audited residual parent is already bound, use 0.19102060916075425
decision.composite_validation_gate: corrected capture - 3 whole-expert SE >= 0.1456888483858212, source exceeds every fixed-descriptor control, every expert/role fold positive, finite, rate/read gates pass, and a separately finite audited residual parent was prospectively bound
decision.standalone_validation_gate: corrected capture - 3 whole-expert SE >= 0.19102060916075425, source exceeds every fixed-descriptor control, every expert/role fold positive, finite, and rate/read gates pass
decision.gate_role_confirmation_after_survival: one shot on the same frozen base seed and ABI, using the exact gate half and an independently committed panel; failure is terminal

physical_ledger.global_descriptor_wire: base_seed u32 little-endian, family_version u16 little-endian, reserved u16 zero
physical_ledger.affine_wire: alpha binary16 little-endian followed by mu binary16 little-endian
physical_ledger.ledger_status: conditional arithmetic only; the 80-byte final ledger is unavailable until the one-shot Gate confirmation supplies all 18 decoded FP16 affine cells and an upstream finite codec/read receipt is bound
